name: Scheme For Women Entrepreneurs Mahila Udyam Nidhi (MUN)
benefit:
- The scheme provides financial assistance for projects with a cost up to ₹10,00,000/-.
- The assistance includes a Term Loan component covering 65% of the project cost.
- The assistance includes a Seed Capital component covering 25% of the project cost.
- The applicant receives a concessional rate of interest that is 0.5% less than the normal interest rate charged for loans.

_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a woman entrepreneur. - The applicant must be setting up a new Small Scale Industrial unit. - The applicant must be setting up a service activity. - The applicant must propose a project with a maximum cost of up to ₹10,00,000/-. _*The applicant is eligible for a concessional rate of interest that is 0.5% less than the normal rate._ _*The applicant is eligible for a 50% concession on the investigation fee._ _*The collateral security requirement is relaxed, mandating the value of the property offered to be fixed at 50% of the loan amount._
